title: Othmar Schwarz
author_source: Simon-Kucher, Managing Partner Austria and Global Head of Technology & Industrials, Vienna office; Wien; practitioner
note: Leads the Vienna office of the world's best-known pricing consultancy (took over from Thomas Haller in 2024). Advises B2B industrial and technology firms on pricing strategy, revenue management and sales excellence; recent insights on big-deal pricing for industrial B2B (2025) and pricing and quoting automation (2026). WU Vienna alumnus (MSc, CEMS MIM), profile states he speaks frequently at universities. German/English.
course_use: Strong guest-lecture fit for B2B value pricing and price execution; on site in Vienna. Good for a session on how a consultancy measures WTP in B2B and turns it into price lists and discount guidelines. Contact via Simon-Kucher Vienna office.

title: Dr. Thomas Haller
author_source: Simon-Kucher, Senior Partner / Managing Director and Head of Energy, Vienna; Wien; practitioner
note: Joined Simon-Kucher in 1999 and led the Vienna office for 17 years; 20+ years in pricing, marketing and sales strategy, focus on energy and industrial markets (e.g. EV-charging pricing, energy tariffs). PhD from WU Vienna (marketing and retail management). German/English.
course_use: Guest lecture or panel on pricing in regulated or utility markets (energy tariffs, e-mobility charging); on site in Vienna. Long WU ties make him a natural alumni speaker.

title: Verena De Smedt-Zuegner
author_source: Simon-Kucher, Partner, Technology, Media & Telecom / Software & Internet, Vienna; Wien; practitioner
note: About 10 years consulting on go-to-market, subscription product design, monetization and pricing for Fortune 500 firms and scale-ups; practice areas pricing strategy and revenue management. WU Vienna double-degree MSc. German/English.
course_use: Ideal for a session on SaaS and subscription pricing, packaging and WTP research for digital products; on site in Vienna or remote. Also a good role model speaker for students considering pricing consulting.

title: Michael Tatschl
author_source: Simon-Kucher, Partner and co-Head of Simon-Kucher Elevate, Vienna; Wien; practitioner
note: 12+ years in consulting; focus on digital commercial transformation, market-testing new offerings with consumers, behavioural sales and as-a-service models; co-authored the 2026 insight on pricing and quoting automation and pieces on AI in sales. WU Vienna alumnus. German/English.
course_use: Fits a session on AI and automation in pricing (dynamic quoting, digital price testing); on site in Vienna. Less pure pricing than Schwarz, so best on a panel.

title: Univ.-Prof. Dr. Thomas Reutterer
author_source: WU Vienna, Professor of Marketing and Head of the Institute for Marketing and Customer Analytics; Wien; academic
note: Co-author of Natter, Reutterer, Mild and Taudes (2007, Marketing Science), a dynamic pricing and promotion decision-support system implemented at an Austrian DIY retailer (reported +8.1% gross profit). Former full-time Simon-Kucher consultant; research on customer-base analysis and machine learning for marketing decisions. German/English.
course_use: In-house WU colleague for a short input on data-driven retail pricing and price promotion analytics, or as discussant of the bauMax/DIY case; on site.

title: Univ.-Prof. Dr. Martin Eisend
author_source: University of Vienna, Professor of Marketing and Head of the Chair of Marketing; adjunct professor CBS; Wien; academic
note: Meta-analysis specialist; co-authored 'A Meta-Analysis of Price Change Fairness Perceptions' (Tarrahi, Eisend and Dost 2016, IJRM), directly relevant to price increases and perceived fairness. His chair advertised a 2025/26 postdoc focused on empirical generalizations in advertising and/or pricing. German/English.
course_use: Short guest input or recorded interview on price fairness and what meta-analyses tell managers about price changes; on site in Vienna (Uni Wien).

title: Univ.-Prof. Dr. Bernadette Kamleitner
author_source: WU Vienna, Professor at the Institute for Marketing & Consumer Research; WU Vice-Rector for Research and Third Mission since 2023; Wien; academic
note: Consumer psychologist; work on mental accounting of payments and credit (Kamleitner and Kirchler 2006, Marketing Letters; Kamleitner and Hoelzl 2009, Applied Psychology on cost-benefit coupling), i.e. the 'pain of paying' mechanisms behind behavioural pricing and payment design. Topic link is behavioural rather than price strategy. German/English.
course_use: Optional guest input on the psychology of paying (subscriptions, BNPL, payment framing); on site at WU. Availability limited by vice-rector role.

title: Andreas Hinterhuber
author_source: Hinterhuber & Partners, Partner (value-based B2B pricing), based in Innsbruck; associate professor of marketing at Ca' Foscari University of Venice per publication bios; Österreich; academic and practitioner
note: One of the most cited value-based pricing authors: co-editor of 'Value First, Then Price' (Routledge, 2nd ed. 2021, with Todd Snelgrove), 'Innovation in Pricing', MIT Sloan Management Review piece with Liozu on setting prices based on customer value, and recent papers on sales variance analysis (JRPM 2023) and WTP for sustainable alpine skiing. Firm says it is 100% focused on pricing. English/German/Italian.
course_use: Excellent remote guest lecture or recorded interview on value quantification in B2B; on site possible via Innsbruck. Fits sessions on EVC/economic value to customer.

title: Univ.-Prof. Dr. Kurt Matzler
author_source: University of Innsbruck, Professor of Strategic Management/Marketing; Österreich; academic
note: Authored early and widely cited work on price satisfaction (dimensions of price satisfaction; 'Preiszufriedenheit: Prospect Theory oder Kano-Modell?' 2002; price and service satisfaction in hotels, Scandinavian Journal of Hospitality and Tourism 2006). Today better known for strategy and leadership, so pricing link is historical. German/English.
course_use: Optional remote input on customer-perceived price and price satisfaction measurement; best as a reading reference rather than main speaker.

title: Matthias Trenkwalder
author_source: Co-founder of RateBoard (Innsbruck, revenue management software for hotels, Zucchetti Group partnership); Österreich; practitioner
note: Co-founded RateBoard in 2015 with Simon Falkensteiner from a University of Innsbruck research project; cloud dynamic pricing tool for leisure hotels in DACH and Italy, reportedly serving 1,400+ hotels by 2025. Current role should be verified (company profile is older). German/English.
course_use: Practical guest talk or remote demo on dynamic pricing and revenue management in Austrian tourism; good for an applied case on algorithmic room pricing.

title: Prof. Dr. Hermann Simon
author_source: Founder and Honorary Chairman of Simon-Kucher; Bonn; Global (DACH); practitioner and communicator
note: Pioneer of pricing management: 'Preismanagement' (standard German textbook), 'Confessions of the Pricing Man', 'Power Pricing' (with Dolan), 'True Profit', 'Die Inflation schlagen'; coined 'Hidden Champions'. Frequent keynote speaker and podcast guest. German/English.
course_use: Keynote or recorded interview (remote) on the economics of price and profit; a short video from his talks works well as course opener. High demand, so plan early.

title: Madhavan Ramanujam
author_source: Simon-Kucher, Senior Partner, San Francisco; Global; practitioner and communicator
note: Author of 'Monetizing Innovation' (2016, with Georg Tacke), known for 'design the product around the price' and early WTP conversations; co-author of 'Scaling Innovation' (2025, with Eddie Hartman). Frequent podcast guest (e.g. Lenny's Podcast) on WTP research for startups. English.
course_use: Recorded talks and podcasts as pre-class material on WTP interviews; remote Q&A possible but difficult to secure.

title: Stephan M. Liozu
author_source: Pricing executive and author (Chief Value Officer roles at Thales and Zilliant reported; founder of Value Innoruption Advisors); adjunct professor and research fellow, Case Western Reserve University; Global; practitioner and academic
note: Prolific author/editor on pricing organisation and value-based pricing: 'Dollarizing Differentiation Value', 'Digital Pricing Strategy' (Routledge 2023, co-ed.), 'Organizing the Pricing Function' (2025); co-author with Hinterhuber of MIT SMR work on value-based pricing. Current employer reported inconsistently; verify. English/French.
course_use: Remote guest lecture on building a pricing function and change management for value pricing.

title: Kyle Poyar
author_source: Author of the newsletter Growth Unhinged; independent advisor (formerly OpenView partner); Global; communicator and practitioner
note: Leading voice on SaaS and AI monetization: publishes the annual State of B2B Monetization report, frameworks for usage-based and AI-agent pricing; newsletter reportedly has ~88,000 subscribers. English.
course_use: Use newsletter posts and benchmark reports as current readings; remote fireside chat feasible (he runs courses and advisory).

title: Mark Stiving
author_source: Host of the Impact Pricing podcast, founder Impact Pricing LLC; Global; communicator and practitioner
note: Long-running B2B pricing podcast (700+ episodes) with frequent episodes on value, buyer insight and willingness to pay (e.g. 2026 debate with Steven Forth on whether buyer context changes WTP). Author of 'Impact Pricing' and 'Selling Value'. PhD in pricing. English.
course_use: Assign podcast episodes; remote guest Q&A plausible given his teaching focus.

title: Tim J. Smith
author_source: Founder and CEO Wiglaf Pricing; adjunct faculty, DePaul University Driehaus College of Business, Chicago; Global; practitioner and academic
note: Author of the textbook 'Pricing Strategy: Setting Price Levels, Managing Price Discounts and Establishing Price Structures' (Cengage 2012) and 'Pricing Done Right' (Wiley 2016); runs Wiglaf Journal. English.
course_use: Textbook author for remote guest lecture on price structures and discount management; course-friendly teaching materials.

title: Thomas T. Nagle
author_source: Co-author of 'The Strategy and Tactics of Pricing'; founder of Strategic Pricing Group (now part of Monitor Deloitte), senior advisor; Global; academic and practitioner
note: His book with Georg Müller is the standard MBA pricing text (value-based pricing, price structure, price policy). Current affiliation not verified in this search. English.
course_use: Mainly as a textbook author; recorded talks rather than live guest lecture.

title: Prof. Dr. Martin Natter
author_source: University of Zurich, Professor of Marketing and Director of the Department of Business Administration (since 2025); former WU Vienna associate professor; Global (Austrian-trained); academic
note: Chair researches innovative pricing and promotion strategies, pay-what-you-want and price-comparison site pricing; co-author of the seminal 2009 Journal of Marketing PWYW paper (Kim, Natter, Spann) and the 2007 Marketing Science dynamic pricing system at an Austrian DIY retailer. German/English.
course_use: Strong remote or on-site (Zurich to Vienna) guest lecture on participative pricing; Austrian background fits WU audience.

title: Prof. Dr. Martin Spann
author_source: LMU Munich, Professor of Marketing (electronic commerce and digital markets); Global (DACH); academic
note: Leading researcher on participative pricing: pay-what-you-want (Journal of Marketing 2009; Management Science 2015 with Schmidt and Zeithammer), name-your-own-price, and WTP elicitation online. German/English.
course_use: Remote guest lecture or recorded interview on PWYW and online WTP measurement.

title: Prof. Dr. Karen Gedenk
author_source: University of Hamburg, Chair of Marketing and Pricing; Global (DACH); academic
note: Holds one of the few explicit pricing chairs in DACH; research on price promotions and pricing; teaches pricing and promotions; former visiting scholar at the University of Vienna. German/English.
course_use: Remote guest lecture on price promotions and their long-term effects; academic counterpart to consultant speakers.

title: Prof. Dr. Klaus M. Miller
author_source: HEC Paris, Associate Professor of Marketing; Global; academic
note: Co-author of the key WTP-measurement comparison 'How Should Consumers' Willingness to Pay Be Measured?' (JMR 2011, with Hofstetter, Krohmer, Zhang) and 'A De-biased Direct Question Approach to Measuring Consumers' WTP' (IJRM 2021). Research on pricing in the digital economy. German/English/French.
course_use: Remote session on choosing a WTP method (direct questions, BDM, incentive-aligned conjoint) for the methods unit.

title: Prof. Dr. Reto Hofstetter
author_source: University of St. Gallen (HSG), Full Professor of Executive Education and Academic Director Executive MBA HSG since 08/2024 (previously University of Lucerne); Global; academic
note: Lead author on incentive-aligned WTP measurement (JMR 2011; IJRM 2021 de-biased direct question approach; GfK MIR 2012 practitioner summary). German/English.
course_use: Remote or on-site guest input on WTP measurement validity; MBA-teaching experience fits Master/MBA audience.

title: Bryan Orme
author_source: Sawtooth Software, President (title reported as CEO in some sources); Global; practitioner and communicator
note: Author of 'Getting Started with Conjoint Analysis' and co-author (with Keith Chrzan) of 'Becoming an Expert in Conjoint Analysis'; 2025 paper 'Three Ways to Treat Overall Price in Conjoint Analysis'; webinars on measuring price sensitivity. English.
course_use: Webinars and short papers as method readings; remote Q&A on conjoint for pricing projects. Sawtooth offers academic licences for student conjoint projects.

title: Elea McDonnell Feit
author_source: Drexel University LeBow College of Business, Associate Professor of Marketing and Associate Dean of Research; Global; academic
note: Co-author of 'R for Marketing Research and Analytics' (with Chapman), which includes choice-based conjoint in R; research on conjoint power and preference measurement; PPS article on pitfalls of conjoint in pricing research. Former GM conjoint practitioner. English.
course_use: Remote guest session or recorded tutorial on running a conjoint WTP study in R.

title: Greg M. Allenby
author_source: Ohio State University, Fisher College of Business, Professor of Marketing; Global; academic
note: Leading figure in Bayesian choice modelling and economic valuation of product features from conjoint data (e.g. work on WTP and market-based price premia from conjoint). Affiliation not re-verified in this search. English.
course_use: Reading reference for advanced conjoint WTP; recorded talks rather than live speaker.

title: Prof. Dr. Florian Bauer
author_source: Co-founder of Vocatus (behavioural pricing consultancy, acquired by Accenture); Honorary Professor, TU Munich; Global (DACH); practitioner and communicator
note: Internationally known speaker on price psychology and behavioural pricing; author of books on price research; guest on Impact Pricing on discounts and behavioural economics in pricing. Current role after the Accenture deal should be checked. German/English.
course_use: Lively guest lecture on psychological pricing (anchoring, framing, price structure); remote or on site (Munich to Vienna).

title: Professional Pricing Society (PPS) and profitABLE26 conferences
author_source: PPS, global professional association; conferences several times a year (2026: Chicago, Atlanta, Amsterdam); Global
note: The largest pricing practitioner association; runs the profitABLE conference series (European edition in Amsterdam, formerly European and Global Pricing Workshops), the Certified Pricing Professional (CPP) programme, the Journal of Professional Pricing and a webinar library. English.
course_use: Students can browse free articles and webinars; membership and conferences are paid (check student rates with PPS). Useful for career orientation and CPP certification.

title: European Pricing Platform (EPP) forums
author_source: EPP, conference organiser; multiple industry pricing forums per year (2026: IGNITE London Sept, Life Sciences Pricing Forum Zurich Oct, 20 Years Global Pricing and RGM Summit Amsterdam Nov; 2027: Retail and Consumer Pricing Paris Feb); Global/Europe
note: Industry-specific practitioner forums (manufacturing, FMCG revenue growth management, retail, life sciences) where pricing heads present cases. English.
course_use: Mine agendas for case examples and potential speakers; attendance is paid and aimed at professionals.

title: Sawtooth Research Conference
author_source: Sawtooth Software; annual conference on conjoint, choice modelling and pricing research (2026: Berlin, 6-8 May); Global
note: Main practitioner-academic meeting for conjoint/choice-based WTP measurement (formerly Sawtooth Software Conference / Analytics and Insights Summit); proceedings and webinars on price sensitivity. English.
course_use: Use free technical papers and webinars in the WTP methods unit; conference and presentation packages are paid.

title: INFORMS Revenue Management and Pricing (RMP) Section Conference
author_source: INFORMS RMP Section; annual academic-practitioner conference (2026: Ross School, University of Michigan, 21-23 July; 2027: CU Boulder, 26-28 June); Global
note: Premier forum for pricing analytics, dynamic pricing and revenue management research; section newsletter and prizes. English.
course_use: Programme and section newsletter point to current dynamic pricing research; relevant for students writing theses on revenue management. Registration paid.

title: ISMS Marketing Science Conference
author_source: INFORMS Society for Marketing Science; annual (2027: Seattle, 24-26 June); Global
note: Largest quantitative marketing conference; many sessions on pricing, WTP estimation, conjoint and dynamic pricing. English.
course_use: Mainly for thesis students and faculty; programme is a good source of current pricing research and speakers.

title: EMAC Annual Conference
author_source: European Marketing Academy; annual, rotating European host (2026: University of Bath, 2-5 June); Europe
note: Key European marketing research conference with a pricing track; many DACH and WU researchers present. English.
course_use: For faculty and doctoral students; programme helps find European pricing researchers as guest speakers.

title: Swiss Pricing Kongress (Schweizer Pricing Kongress)
author_source: ESB Marketing Netzwerk; annual since 2025, alongside the Swiss Brand Congress (2026: 10 June, Dolder Grand Zurich); DACH
note: Closest DACH executive pricing conference; 2026 themes AI, data and new price models, with cases from NZZ, SBB, AutoScout24 and TWINT. German.
course_use: Use published speaker articles as German-language cases; executive tickets paid. Speakers are a pool for DACH guest lectures.

title: ZHAW Pricing Lab
author_source: Zurich University of Applied Sciences, Institute of Marketing Management; competence centre for pricing in DACH; Winterthur/Zurich
note: Applied pricing research and consulting hub that presents itself as a pricing competence centre for the DACH region; source of studies and events. German.
course_use: Check for public studies and events; potential academic-practitioner partner for student projects.

title: Impact Pricing podcast
author_source: Mark Stiving; weekly podcast (several episodes per week); Global, online
note: Hundreds of episodes on value-based B2B pricing, buyer insight and WTP, with guests such as Florian Bauer, Tim J. Smith and Stephan Liozu. English.
course_use: Free listening; assign 20-30 minute episodes as pre-class material.

title: Growth Unhinged newsletter
author_source: Kyle Poyar; weekly newsletter with paid premium tier; Global, online
note: Benchmark-driven posts on SaaS and AI pricing, packaging and monetization; annual State of B2B Monetization report; readership ~88,000. English.
course_use: Free tier sufficient for course readings; premium USD 15/month optional.

title: Actuarial Modelling Club TU Wien (pricing talks)
author_source: TU Wien, Research Unit Financial and Actuarial Mathematics; irregular free evening talks; Wien
note: Vienna lecture series that has hosted pricing talks, e.g. on market pricing and dynamic pricing strategies (Deloitte, Nov 2023) and insurance pricing (Wüstenrot, Milliman, Akur8, May 2024). German.
course_use: Free, on site in Vienna; students can attend for local practitioner contacts on (insurance) dynamic pricing. Topic-specific only for pricing editions.
